transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I came in because this low feeling has been hanging around for a long time. I still get through my routes and my volunteer shifts, but most days it feels heavy, like I’m just going through the motions instead of really being part of my own life.
How long have you been experiencing this low feeling?
About three years now. It really started after my father died, and it just hasn’t gone away since then.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I still do some of the things I used to do, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether they feel enjoyable the same way. It’s kind of hard for me to say.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

I don’t know if I’d say I’ve lost interest exactly. I still do some things, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether I enjoy them like I used to. It’s more like I just do what I’m supposed to do.
Do you feel like you've been enjoying things less than you used to?
I’m not really sure. I guess I haven’t been paying close attention to whether I enjoy things less. I still do some things, but it’s hard for me to say if they feel different than before.
Are there things that you used to enjoy that you no longer find pleasure in?
I can’t really point to a specific thing, honestly. I still do some of the same stuff, but I haven’t noticed clearly that I don’t get pleasure from it anymore. It’s kind of hard for me to tell.
Do you feel like you've been looking forward to things less often than you used to?
I’m not sure, really. I don’t think I’ve been paying attention to whether I look forward to things or not. I mostly just take things as they come.
Do you feel like you've lost pleasure in activities that you used to find enjoyable?
I don’t know that I’d say I’ve lost pleasure, exactly. I still do some of the things I usually do. I just haven’t really noticed one way or the other if they feel less enjoyable.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that would normally bring you happiness?
I’m not sure I’d say I’m unable to feel pleasure. I haven’t really noticed it that clearly. Some things are still okay, I guess—I just don’t think about it much.
Do you feel like things that used to make you happy no longer have any effect on you?

I don’t know if I’d put it that strongly. I haven’t really noticed things having no effect on me. Some stuff still seems fine, I guess—I just don’t pay much attention to whether it makes me happy like it used to.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities or things that would normally bring you happiness?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’m unable to enjoy things. I just don’t pay close attention to it, and nothing really stands out to me that way.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past three years?
Not really, no. I haven’t noticed any big weight changes over that time.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep?

Yeah, some. Especially the nights before a run, I’ll lay there thinking about the next day’s stops. Sometimes I wake up around four and can’t really get back to sleep. I still get to work, but I feel like I’m already worn out when the day starts.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower than usual, and I’m not really the type to be pacing around or unable to sit still.
Have you been having any thoughts about death or dying?
No, I wouldn’t say that. I don’t really have thoughts about death or dying.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?
No, I haven’t thought about harming myself.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt better and your low mood lifted?
No, not really. It’s been going on for about three years now, since my father died. I might have okay days here and there, but I can’t say it’s lifted for a couple weeks.
Have you had any periods, even if just for a few days, where you felt significantly better than you do most of the time?
Not really. Like I said, it’s been pretty steady for about three years, since my dad died. I might have a better day here or there, but nothing where I felt significantly better for a few days.
Have you ever had a period, even if just for a few days, where your low mood seemed to lift and you felt like your old self again?
No, I don’t think so. It’s pretty much been this way for about three years now, since my father died. I haven’t really felt like my old self again.
Have you had any periods, even if just for a month or more, where you felt significantly better than you do most of the time?
No, I can’t say I’ve had a month or anything like that where I felt much better. It’s just been going on pretty steady for about three years, since my father died.
